title: Cosmic Customs cargo facts
description: Read only what the packet states. Use null when a value is unknown. Use the string missing only when the packet explicitly says the item is not on file. Do not repair contradictions.

is_singing_or_telepathic.title: Singing or telepathic
is_singing_or_telepathic.description: True when the packet says the cargo is singing or telepathic. False when it explicitly says neither. Null when the packet does not say.

hazard_class.title: Hazard class
hazard_class.description: other for ordinary freight. class4_acoustic only when the packet says acoustic class 4. Null when unknown.

cert_status.title: Certificate status
cert_status.description: missing means the packet explicitly says the certificate is not on file. Null means the status is unknown.

waiver_status.title: Waiver status
waiver_status.description: missing means an emergency waiver is explicitly not on file. Null means unknown or not stated.

seal_status.title: Seal status
seal_status.description: damaged only for a confirmed present defect. A corrected historical suspicion is not damaged. Null when unknown.

seal_pressure_kpa.title: Seal pressure
seal_pressure_kpa.description: The printed nonnegative kilopascal reading as a decimal string, or null when no readable measurement is present. Do not invent a number.

manifest_gross_weight_kg.title: Manifest gross weight
manifest_gross_weight_kg.description: The printed positive manifest gross weight in kilograms as a decimal string, or null when it is not stated.

certificate_gross_weight_kg.title: Certificate gross weight
certificate_gross_weight_kg.description: The printed positive certificate gross weight in kilograms as a decimal string, or null when it is not stated.

conflicted_fields.title: Conflicted fields
conflicted_fields.description: Names of fields whose statements in the packet do not agree. Empty when there is no contradiction.
